title: Morocco - April 1st 2025 Tour
text:
It is a long day!
Tour guide in Morocco was exceptional!
So-So on Naturanda 
I was very disappointed in the last-minute pick-up time change.  It was moved to 6:45 AM from 7:30 which prevented one of our paid for travelers from making the trip. (morning medicine regiment)
author: Denny_W
